channel.title: The Ashgrove Times — The News Desk
channel.description: For the Fellers — the morning paper, filed daily at 7:00 AM ET.

item.title: No. 111 — Army detonates 68 barrels of unstable lead azide at Iowa plant
item.description: EPA monitors found no airborne lead in the first hours; residents within 5 miles had been told to leave

item.title: No. 110 — Abrego Garcia leaves U.S. for Spain, ending two-year deportation fight
item.description: Lawyers say he departed Dulles on a commercial flight rather than on an ICE plane to Liberia

item.title: No. 109 — Nvidia reinstates Huang as CEO; Nasdaq posts its best day since April 2025
item.description: The board voted unanimously 11 days after he resigned over an affair with an alleged Chinese agent; Trump called it the 'correct and proper decision'

item.title: No. 108 — Ukrainian sea drones sink Russian corvette Merkury at Libyan port
item.description: Zelensky confirmed the Benghazi strike Monday; Libya's eastern government asked the UN to investigate where the drones came from

item.title: No. 107 — Mexico captures cartel boss 'El Chapo Isidro' as 11 die in Sinaloa fighting
item.description: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores was on the FBI's 10 most wanted list; four soldiers and seven alleged gunmen were killed in Guasave

item.title: No. 106 — S&P 500 and Dow enter correction as Nasdaq erases its 2026 gains
item.description: The Nasdaq lost 1,261 points, or 5.3%, its second-worst day of the year; the S&P 500 fell for a seventh straight session

item.title: No. 105 — Anthropic closes 17% above IPO price as Dow sheds 1,101 points
item.description: The $81.3B offering is the largest ever; the Dow's 49,097 close was its first below 50,000 since June

item.title: No. 104 — Trump, Xi and Putin meet for 90 minutes in Shenzhen, issue no statement
item.description: Xi called nuclear weapons a "sword of Damocles" in opening remarks; Trump flew home as soon as the talks ended

item.title: No. 103 — Nvidia posts record $115.8B quarter as board rules out Huang's return
item.description: Shares rose about 4% after hours; interim CEO Colette Kress said demand remains well above supply

item.title: No. 102 — Section of the Crimean Bridge collapses after a second night of Ukrainian strikes
item.description: Russia suspended road and rail traffic across the Kerch Strait; missiles hit two Kyiv bridges the same night

item.title: No. 101 — ULA's Vulcan rocket fails, losing 40 Amazon internet satellites
item.description: The Centaur upper stage faltered 10 minutes after Sunday's Cape Canaveral liftoff, the first total loss for ULA since it formed in 2006

item.title: No. 100 — SpaceX catches a Starship returning from orbit for the first time
item.description: Tower arms grabbed Ship 42 at Starbase on Saturday, 22 hours after liftoff; Friday's booster was lost over the Gulf

item.title: No. 99 — FAA grounds every U.S. departure for four hours, blames aging routers
item.description: More than 4,000 flights were canceled; Duffy says old switches overloaded and Mullin says there was no cyberattack

item.title: No. 98 — Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia's chief executive after 33 years
item.description: Finance chief Colette Kress takes over on an interim basis; shares closed down 4.3% and House chairs gave Huang until Friday evening to agree to testify

item.title: No. 97 — Colom beats Hyde-Smith in Mississippi for Democrats' eighth Senate flip
item.description: The AP called the race Wednesday after days of absentee and provisional counting; Colom is the state's first Black senator since Reconstruction

item.title: No. 96 — House votes 211-204 to bury Hegseth impeachment for this Congress
item.description: Massie was the only Republican to vote no, 11 Democrats were absent and Jeffries called it 'just the beginning'

item.title: No. 95 — Trump calls Iran war 'effectively over' but keeps the blockade in place
item.description: After meeting Qatar's prime minister, he said more strikes don't seem necessary and the U.S. is 'locked and loaded'

item.title: No. 94 — Trump says deportation drive was 'too tough' after midterm rout
item.description: In a 60 Minutes interview, the president gave himself an A+ on the border and said he would attack Iran again

item.title: No. 93 — Gunman kills 6 in Krakow's main square; Poland calls it terrorism
item.description: Three relatives found dead at the suspect's home; the interior minister said he was drawn to far-right ideology

item.title: No. 92 — Trump names Stephen Miller chief of staff, replacing Wiles
item.description: Wiles resigned Thursday night after the midterm losses; Miller, architect of the deportation program, starts Monday

item.title: No. 91 — Nasdaq falls into correction as AI selloff wipes out midterm rally
item.description: The Dow sheds 1,833 points and Nvidia drops 9.2% as investors weigh Democrats' scrutiny of AI data centers

item.title: No. 90 — Johnson steps aside as House GOP leader after midterm losses
item.description: Scalise and Jordan seek the post before a Nov. 10 vote; Trump weighs Hegseth's future, sources say

item.title: No. 89 — Democrats win House and Senate, ending Republican control of Congress
item.description: Seven GOP Senate seats flipped, Maine, Texas and Kansas among them; Alaska and Mississippi still uncalled

item.title: No. 88 — U.S. strikes Iranian targets on Qeshm Island on the eve of Election Day
item.description: Officials call the Hormuz strikes defensive; Tehran's parliament speaker warns of 'a new battlefield'

item.title: No. 87 — Private jet nose-dives onto Palm Beach County road, killing all 9 aboard
item.description: Pilot radioed a mayday as the Learjet fell 20,000 feet a minute; 600 evacuated from a mobile home park

item.title: No. 86 — Trump says 'one or two' Iran targets remain as Tehran floats Hormuz plan
item.description: Khamenei warns of no geographic limits if war resumes; Qatar says an LNG carrier was hit Friday in the Gulf

item.title: No. 85 — Tech sell-off erases $1 trillion as Intel posts its worst day
item.description: Nasdaq 100 falls 3.4%, its worst day since June, as investors question returns on AI spending

item.title: No. 84 — Binance says hackers stole $6.3B in largest crypto theft on record
item.description: The exchange halted withdrawals and said about $3B tied to the attackers is frozen; analysts point to North Korea

item.title: No. 83 — Spain's rail toll reaches 68 as minister blames restart order
item.description: Puente says controllers restarted the Renfe train with no speed limit after a signal failure; three days of mourning begin

item.title: No. 82 — Israel's election ends with no majority as Netanyahu bloc leads count
item.description: With 72% counted, Netanyahu's bloc holds 54 seats and Eisenkot's 48; final results are due Friday
